name: Turkey, Zucchini, and Tomato
instructions: Turkey and vegetables in the pot with oil and spices.
LOW 4 hours. Slice into 4.
Eat turkey first.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Mediterranean vegetables, turkey instead of a heavy stew.

name: Turkey Cucumber Plate
instructions: Sous vide the turkey at 146°F.
Slice and serve cold or warm over cucumber with oil, dill, and lemon.
4 oz turkey each.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: A cold lunch. Search 'soft' if you want the yogurt plates instead.

name: Oregano Turkey and Cabbage
instructions: Turkey on cabbage with oregano, oil, and pepper.
LOW 5 hours. Cabbage should be sweet and soft.
4 boxes. Lemon at the table.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Cabbage replaces bread. Fridge 4 days.

name: Paprika Turkey and Peppers
instructions: Bag turkey with paprika and pepper. 146°F for 2 hours.
Eat with raw peppers, oil, and lemon.
5 oz turkey.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Protein first, peppers after.

name: Beef and Spinach Eggs
instructions: Stir beef, eggs, whites, spinach, and spices.
LOW 2.5–3.5 hours. Beef should have no pink.
4 portions.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Lean beef only. Drain any liquid before you box it.

name: Beef Strips and Eggs
instructions: Bag the sirloin with pepper and garlic. 132°F.
Jammy eggs, 167°F for 13 minutes.
4 oz beef and 1 egg, with lemon.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Slice beef thin. That is the softer way to eat it.

name: Beef, Pepper, and Tomato
instructions: Beef and vegetables, LOW 6 hours, until the beef is tender.
Divide into 4. Spoon off extra fat.
Beef first, then the vegetables.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Long cook makes it soft. No gravy packet.

name: Beef on a Tomato Salad
instructions: Sirloin at 132°F for 2 hours. Rest and slice.
Tomatoes with oil, oregano, pepper, and lemon.
4 oz beef on the salad.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Mediterranean lunch. No roll.

name: Beef and Cauliflower
instructions: Beef and cauliflower with spices and oil.
LOW until the beef shreds.
4 portions. Beef first.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Cauliflower is the side, not a mash loaded with butter.

name: Rosemary Beef and Zucchini
instructions: Bag beef with rosemary and pepper. 132°F.
Zucchini raw or warmed in the oil.
5 oz beef, then zucchini and lemon.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: A small plate. Stop when the beef is gone.

name: Pork and Greens Egg Bake
instructions: Stir pork, eggs, whites, spinach, and spices.
LOW 2.5–3.5 hours. Pork at 145°F and eggs set.
4 portions.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Tenderloin, not sausage. Sausage is salted.

name: Lemon Pork and Eggs
instructions: Bag pork with fennel and pepper. 140°F.
Eggs jammy. Lemon on the pork.
4 oz pork and 1 egg.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Fennel seed is the Mediterranean note. No salt.

name: Pork, Cabbage, and Tomato
instructions: Pork on cabbage and tomatoes with oil and oregano.
LOW 5 hours.
4 boxes. Pork first.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: A braise without wine or broth cubes.

name: Pork and Cucumber
instructions: Tenderloin at 140°F. Slice thin.
Cucumber with oil, oregano, lemon, and pepper.
4 oz pork.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Cold slices are a lunch, not a snack.

name: Fennel Lemon Pork
instructions: Pork, fennel, garlic, lemon, oil, and pepper.
LOW 5 hours. Fennel soft, pork 145°F.
4 portions.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Mediterranean pork. No applesauce.

name: Oregano Pork and Peppers
instructions: Bag pork with oregano and pepper. 140°F.
Peppers raw or warmed in oil.
5 oz pork, then peppers and lemon.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Protein first.

name: Dill Salmon and Eggs
instructions: Salmon in the pot, eggs and whites poured around it with dill and pepper.
LOW 1.5–2 hours. Salmon flakes, eggs just set.
4 portions, lemon on top.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Do not leave salmon on HIGH. It dries out. Soft if you flake it.

name: Salmon and Soft Eggs
instructions: Salmon at 125°F for 30–40 minutes with dill and pepper.
Eggs at 167°F for 13 minutes.
4 oz salmon and 1 egg, oil and lemon.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Soft plate if you flake the salmon. Search 'soft'.

name: Salmon and Zucchini
instructions: Zucchini under the salmon. Dill, pepper, oil.
LOW about 1.5 hours, until it flakes.
4 portions.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Eat the salmon before the zucchini.

name: Salmon on Greens (Sous Vide, greens)
instructions: Salmon at 125°F.
Greens with oil and lemon.
4 oz salmon on the greens.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Mediterranean lunch. No crackers.

name: Tomato Oregano Salmon
instructions: Tomatoes, oregano, oil, and pepper under the salmon.
LOW 1.5 hours.
4 portions. Salmon first.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: A soft dinner if you flake it.

name: Lemon Fennel Salmon
instructions: Salmon at 125°F with pepper.
Shaved fennel with oil and lemon.
5 oz salmon, then fennel.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.
tips: Fennel stays raw and crisp.

name: Herb Egg and Yogurt Bake

LOW 2.5–3 hours until just set.
4 portions.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.

tips: Soft plate. Search 'soft'.

name: Pepper and Tomato Egg Loaf

LOW until set. Rest 10 minutes.
4 slices.

Tomatoes with oil, oregano, and pepper.

doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.

name: Spinach Oregano Egg Bake
instructions: Eggs, whites, spinach, oregano, and spices.
LOW until set.
4 portions.
doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.

Yogurt with dill, lemon, and pepper. Cucumber beside it.

doneWhen: The protein is cooked through and boxed in even portions.

Tomatoes, oil, oregano, lemon, and pepper.
